name: Design Alert
description: Family of 10 alert and callout designs (soft, side icon, solid, gradient banner, toast card, announcement, tip, quote, inline, panel) with success, warning, danger, info and neutral states. Follows the inline alert pattern of Universal Theme and modern design systems: the state is shown by semantic color plus an icon and a text label, never by color alone. Renders one alert (partial) or a stack of alerts from a query (report).
helpText: Pick a Style for the region. Map State to a column or static value returning success, warning, danger, info or neutral; any other value renders as neutral. Danger alerts use role=alert, all others role=status. Icon defaults to a state icon when left empty. The link renders only when both Link URL and Link Label are set.

attributes.name: Style
attributes.helpText: Visual design of the alert. Soft: tinted box. Side Icon: icon block on the start side. Solid: filled with the state color. Gradient Banner: wide tinted banner with a call-to-action pill. Toast Card: floating card with time stamp. Announcement: centered news block. Tip: dashed callout with a floating icon badge. Quote: quoted message with attribution. Inline: compact pill for forms. Panel: header bar with state label, body and footer link.

attributes.name: State
attributes.helpText: success, warning, danger, info or neutral. Any other or empty value renders as neutral. Danger alerts are announced immediately with role=alert.

attributes.name: Title
attributes.helpText: Short headline, for example Invoice INV-2041 is overdue.

attributes.name: Message
attributes.helpText: Supporting sentence that says what happened and what to do next. In the Quote style this is the quoted text.

attributes.name: Icon
attributes.helpText: Font APEX icon class, for example fa-truck. Leave empty to use the state icon: check for success, triangle for warning, cross for danger, info for info, bell for neutral.

attributes.name: Meta Text
attributes.helpText: Optional small text: a time stamp for Toast Card, a release or date for Announcement, the author for Quote. Format dates in SQL with the application's NLS settings.

attributes.name: Link URL
attributes.helpText: Optional target, for example f?p=&APP_ID.:20:&SESSION.::NO::P20_ID:&P10_ID. or a column holding apex_page.get_url(...). Must be developer-controlled, never end-user input.

attributes.name: Link Label
attributes.helpText: Visible link text, for example Review invoice. The link renders only when both Link URL and Link Label are set.
